baseline_models.focus_anchor: أَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلذِّكْرَىٰ ... جَآءَهُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّبِينٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: The interrogative asks for the route or manner by which reminder could become theirs, while the completed arrival of a message-bearing clarifier says that the route had already reached them. The contrast between لَهُم and جَآءَهُمْ separates external delivery from internal possession.

activation_trace.role: The whence-or-how inquiry literally tests source and manner, and here tests the route by which reminder could become theirs.
The reminder image supplies the cognitive result whose failed acquisition the question diagnoses.
Concrete arrival supplies the completed external approach against which failed uptake is measured.
Messenger and carried message identify the arrival as a communicative delivery rather than mere presence.
Disclosure by expression or sign makes the messenger the means by which intended meaning was exposed.

changed_reading.before: A flat exclamation that they do not remember.
changed_reading.after: A diagnostic question: by what route could reminder become theirs when a clarifying delivery reached them without becoming theirs?

baseline_models.mechanism: The split inventory around أَنَّىٰ overlays the ordinary how-or-whence question with delay, due completion, and a non-dominant time-or-occasion branch. With قَدْ marking arrival as accomplished, remembrance can be heard as uptake that has an occasion and can become belated.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate delay supplies the possibility that the failure is postponed response rather than absent information.
Reaching due completion gives the response window a ripening point after which recall changes character.
The non-dominant time-and-occasion image keeps a temporal reading alive alongside the normal interrogative one.
Bringing something back to mind supplies delayed recognition as distinct from timely reception.
Completed arrival establishes the prior event from which lateness can be reckoned.

changed_reading.before: The question concerns only the logical possibility of remembering.
changed_reading.after: It also asks from what still-open occasion recall could arise after the messenger's completed arrival; delayed recognition may have missed its due moment.

baseline_models.mechanism: The envoy can bring a message to an audience, but remembrance becomes for them only through a relation of openness. The connection branch of مُّبِين and the trusting-ease branch of رَسُول make reception relational rather than automatic.

activation_trace.role: Bringing or presenting something makes the arrival a transfer offered to the audience.
Trusting ease and openness supply the interpersonal condition under which an envoy's delivery can be received.
The tie between parties supplies a live channel connecting messenger and hearers.
Mental recollection supplies the inward uptake that a merely external approach cannot guarantee.

changed_reading.before: A messenger's physical arrival should itself produce reminder.
changed_reading.after: Arrival offers a connection, but reminder becomes theirs only if the audience enters the trust relation carried by the envoy.

baseline_models.mechanism: The rights-document branch of ذ ك ر permits a procedural resonance: the clarifying envoy has already presented an intelligible notice or record. The question can therefore challenge not only memory but any later claim to have lacked notice.

activation_trace.role: The rights-document image supplies an inspectable record or notice as an exploratory register of the reminder.
Presentation supplies the procedural act by which the notice is made available.
The envoy-and-message image supplies an authorized carrier for the presented notice.
Becoming visible or clear makes the notice publicly ascertainable rather than hidden.

changed_reading.before: The reminder is only a private mental recollection.
changed_reading.after: It can also resonate as prior notice made visible through an envoy, undercutting a later claim that no intelligible warning arrived.

baseline_models.mechanism: A form-distant but packet-licensed material model joins the vessel branch under أَنَّىٰ to the flowing-yield branch under رَسُول. It asks whether the audience has become a receiving interior for reminder, while the connection branch of مُّبِين supplies the conduit.

activation_trace.role: The vessel image supplies an exploratory receiving interior for what is delivered.
Milk and continuous yield supply a material flow image for the messenger's communicative output.
The connecting tie functions as the conduit between the flowing source and possible receiver.
Inward recollection supplies the cognitive content that the material vessel analogy tries to model.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the question tests whether there is any receptive interior and live conduit in which the messenger's yielded reminder can lodge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context turns the focus arrival into the human-facing endpoint of a staged transmission: written composition, delivery downward, differentiation of content, dispatch, then facilitated linguistic conveyance aimed at remembrance. Reminder is not expected to arise spontaneously; it is the intended uptake of a deliberately routed message.

activation_trace.role: Messenger and carried message anchor the focus as the personal delivery stage of the chain.
Reminder supplies the intended endpoint produced if the delivered chain is received.
Disclosing intended meaning gives the messenger a decoding function at the chain's audience-facing end.
Ordered letters and the written object literally supply the encoded beginning of the transmission.
Causing something to descend and reach its destination supplies the delivery step after encoding.
Distinguishing between things supplies articulated content rather than an undifferentiated signal.
Sending forth supplies the explicit dispatch that precedes the focus messenger's arrival.
Ease after difficulty shows that the final communicative form was made accessible rather than left obstructed.
Conveying a message by tongue names the linguistic handoff to the audience.
The closing reminder branch states the reception outcome toward which the whole chain is directed.

structural_cues: Ayat 44:2-5 sequence book, descent, differentiation, and dispatch; 44:58 closes the surah with facilitated language so that they may remember.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered delivery stages and a closing purpose clause; I connect them as one transmission pipeline whose human endpoint is the focus messenger. They could instead be parallel descriptions without a single causal chain.

changed_reading.before: One messenger happened to arrive as a single past proof.
changed_reading.after: The messenger is the last visible relay in a designed transmission, so the question diagnoses failed uptake after every delivery stage was supplied.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night intervals, watching, return after temporary relief, denied respite, an appointed time, and the lexical crossover between delay and molten boiling activate the delay, occasion, and due-completion branches under أَنَّىٰ. The reminder available before crisis ripens into belated recognition during crisis; the latter is not equivalent to timely receptive remembrance.

activation_trace.role: Deliberate delay anchors the audience's postponed response as the temporal defect under examination.
Due completion, including heat reaching its limit, supplies the ripening threshold at which delay becomes consequence.
The non-dominant occasion image keeps the question sensitive to whether a response window remains.
Recall after lapse supplies the late recognition that must be distinguished from earlier heed.
The bounded darkness of night supplies the first marked temporal interval for delivery.
Watching and waiting opens an explicit period in which the coming sign is anticipated.
Return after departure makes temporary relief a cycle rather than a reset of the missed response.
Waiting for time and granting respite supply the withheld extension of a response interval.
A fixed appointment supplies the terminal boundary toward which the temporal sequence moves.
Deliberateness and leaving haste literally reactivate the focus delay image at the punishment description.
Molten substances and sediments make the same contextual token pivot from delay into heated matter.
A pot boiling over materializes the focus branch of heat reaching its limit.
Nearness and the arrival of an affair supply the moment when deferred consequence becomes present.

structural_cues: The plea at 44:12 comes only after the smoke, the focus marks the messenger's arrival as already completed, and 44:15 promises only a little removal before return.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring intervals, waiting, return, appointment, delay, and boiling; I infer that receptive remembrance has a window that can ripen and close. A live alternative is that أَنَّىٰ expresses impossibility with no temporal component.

changed_reading.before: They could begin remembering whenever pressure made them ask for relief.
changed_reading.after: Their crisis response is late recognition after the reminder's due occasion; delay has ripened into consequence, so relief-language does not restore timely remembrance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The repeated مُّبِين labels span book, smoke, authority, and trial, while neighboring branches distinguish, uncover, compel by proof, and finally separate at judgment. The focus messenger is therefore not only verbally lucid: his arrival manifests what was hidden and draws a consequential boundary between responses.

activation_trace.role: Appearance and becoming clear anchor the messenger as a manifestation that can be publicly recognized.
Separation and parting add the consequence that manifestation distinguishes one response from another.
Disclosure through speech or sign preserves the ordinary communicative force inside the broader separating model.
The book discloses meaning by expression and establishes that clarity can inhere in a communicative object.
Distinguishing and separating supplies the sorting action performed within the revelatory sequence.
The smoke's visible manifestation shows that مُّبِين can disclose through an event, not only through speech.
Lifting a cover supplies the audience's own demand for reversal of an already manifest disclosure.
Compelling proof supplies a forceful evidentiary mode for the later مُّبِين authority.
Disclosure by sign makes the authority legible rather than merely coercive.
A manifest trial broadens clarity into an event that exposes the hearer's condition.
A judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the terminal form of the boundary first exposed by the messenger.

structural_cues: The adjective مُّبِين recurs with book, smoke, messenger, authority, and trial, and the sequence culminates in يَوْمَ ٱلْفَصْلِ.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recurring manifestation and separation images; I infer that disclosure causes a sorting of responses and that the messenger inaugurates that boundary. The live alternative is that each مُّبِين only means locally obvious or eloquent.

changed_reading.before: The messenger merely explained the warning in clear words.
changed_reading.after: The messenger's arrival itself made the concealed issue manifest and began a separation later completed as judgment; clarity is event and verdict as well as speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel reverses approach into withdrawal and replaces the messenger's disclosure with an allegation that his mind is covered. The Moses parallel explicitly joins messengerhood to trust, while later isolation language confirms that reception depends on a relation the audience can sever.

activation_trace.role: Trusting ease and openness anchor the messenger as a relationship offered to the audience.
The tie between parties supplies the connective channel through which reminder could become theirs.
Presentation supplies the offer whose mere delivery does not compel relational uptake.
Turning away literally severs the orientation opened by the messenger's approach.
Saying or attributing what was not so supplies the audience's counter-description of the messenger.
A mind covered by madness turns the clarifier into the alleged site of concealment.
The parallel messenger's trusting openness makes relational credibility explicit.
Security and settled trust name the receptive relation embodied by the trustworthy messenger.
Moving something aside and isolating it supplies the endpoint of a failed communicative relation.

structural_cues: The pronoun path moves from جَآءَهُمْ in 44:13 to تَوَلَّوْا عَنْهُ in 44:14, changing approach into withdrawal before the messenger is relabeled.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies approach, withdrawal, counter-speech, concealed reason, trust, and isolation; I infer that becoming لَهُم requires receptive relation, not physical proximity alone. Alternatively, rejected reminder may still be theirs as incriminating notice.

changed_reading.before: Their failure is a shortage of understandable evidence.
changed_reading.after: The evidence arrived through a trust-bearing relation, but they broke the relation and recoded the clarifier as mad; the blockage is enacted reception, not intelligibility.

context_deltas.mechanism: Written obligation, awakening warning, command, judgment, compelling proof, established right, and final adjudication activate the rights-document branch of ذِكْرَىٰ. The focus can carry a procedural reading in which the messenger's prior arrival constitutes intelligible notice before the audience's crisis claim.

activation_trace.role: The deed or rights-document image anchors a procedural register for the reminder.
Bringing and presenting supplies the act by which notice is served to its recipients.
The envoy carrying speech supplies an authorized bearer of the notice.
A written establishment that obliges judgment or decree supplies the formal backdrop for notice.
Warning that awakens precaution supplies notice's preventive purpose before consequence.
Request and binding obligation supply the normative content carried by the notice.
Judgment between parties supplies the adjudicative horizon against which prior notice matters.
Compelling proof supplies evidentiary authority rather than unsupported assertion.
Binding due and established entitlement activate the rights-bearing side of the focus document branch.
Final judgment separating truth from falsehood supplies the proceeding for which notice was given.

structural_cues: The request to remove punishment in 44:12 is followed by the focus's وَقَدْ, which foregrounds that the messenger had already arrived before the claim of belief.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a document branch plus obligation, warning, proof, right, and judgment images; I infer a service-of-notice analogy and treat the crisis plea as procedurally late. The mnemonic-admonitory reading remains primary and fully live.

changed_reading.before: Their plea can be taken as a fresh claim to belief once punishment appears.
changed_reading.after: The focus asks how that late claim can function as valid reminder when intelligible warning had already been served by an authorized envoy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus first directs motion toward the audience: a gently proceeding envoy came to them. Later movement reverses under force as seizure and violent dragging move the rejecter toward punishment. The focus question becomes the hinge between offered approach and compelled transport.

activation_trace.role: Arrival supplies the initial vector in which the messenger moves toward the audience.
Driving or compelling keeps a latent coercive vector available for contextual reversal.
Gentleness and deliberate pace characterize the offered approach as non-coercive.
Seizing with overpowering force introduces the later coercive mode of movement.
The repeated arrival of a messenger confirms the offered-toward-them vector as a recurring pattern.
The messenger's deliberate gentleness keeps the parallel arrival distinct from later force.
Coming toward the hearers with authority repeats the approach before the direction reverses.
Driving and dragging violently supplies the reversed vector in which the former recipient is now compelled away.

structural_cues: The grammatical recipient in جَآءَهُمْ is approached by the messenger, whereas the later imperative خُذُوهُ فَٱعْتِلُوهُ makes the rejecter the object moved by force.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opposite motion patterns and a focus branch that includes compelling; I infer a narrative reversal from gracious approach to forced transport. The alternative is that the two motion scenes are only sequential, not intentionally mirrored.

changed_reading.before: The messenger's coming is an isolated fact with no spatial consequence.
changed_reading.after: His gentle movement toward them is the offered alternative to the later scene in which rejection reverses agency and they are moved by force.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the form-distant vessel and milk-yield branches rather than glossing أَنَّىٰ or رَسُول directly. It remains anchored in the focus's receiving, messenger, connection, and recollection roots, while covering, interior, molten, boiling, pouring, and message-conveyance branches sustain a coherent filling reversal. Downstream prose should label it a material analogy, not a lexical translation.

activation_trace.role: The vessel image supplies the possible receptive interior in the focus.
Continuous milk or yield supplies a nourishing flow image for what the messenger offers.
The tie between parties supplies the conduit through which the offered flow could enter reception.
Inward recollection identifies the cognitive filling modeled by the material analogy.
A covering that envelops all supplies the first punitive filling or saturation after failed reception.
Molten matter supplies the punitive substance that replaces the unreceived reminder.
Boiling over supplies violent internal motion rather than settled cognitive uptake.
The inside of a thing locates the later punitive filling in the very interior left unreceptive.
Pouring supplies an imposed downward flow that contrasts with the messenger's offered yield.
Conveying the message by tongue confirms that the nourishing flow image still refers to communication.

changed_reading.before: Reminder and punishment occupy unrelated abstract and physical domains.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, the messenger offers a flow toward a possible inner vessel; refusal leaves that interior to be overtaken later by covering, boiling, and imposed pouring.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ذِكْرَىٰ most directly names reminder, but its honorable-mention branch remains focus-anchored and the context repeatedly stages noble status, defamatory speech, and a later ironic noble title. The reading should be carried as a secondary social resonance, not as a replacement gloss.

activation_trace.role: Honorable mention and renown supply a social-status resonance for what could be theirs.
The messenger role identifies the person whose reception or defamation tests that honor.
False attribution supplies the public speech act that replaces honorable recognition with defamation.
Madness as covered reason supplies the dishonoring label attached to the clarifying messenger.
Praiseworthy nobility identifies the parallel messenger as genuinely honorable.
Might and honor supply one half of the later status formula turned against the rejecter.
Nobility supplies the other half of the ironic title that exposes failed claims to honor.

changed_reading.before: The question denies only cognitive remembrance.
changed_reading.after: It also asks how honorable mention could accrue to people who answered an honorable envoy with public defamation and whose own honor-language is later exposed as hollow.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the night-interval branch is not the normal syntax of أَنَّىٰ. It remains packet-anchored through that exact focus root and gains structure from revelation and rescue both occurring at night, with watching and fixed appointment around them. It should be rendered as a temporal echo or activation, never as a direct translation.

activation_trace.role: Night intervals supply a latent bounded-window image inside the focus interrogative root.
The non-dominant occasion image gives the night interval a temporal rather than merely atmospheric function.
Undertaking an affair at night makes revelation an operation within a marked nocturnal window.
Undertaking the rescue at night repeats the pattern of decisive action in a bounded nocturnal interval.
Watching and waiting supply the interval-sensitive posture surrounding the missed window.
A fixed appointment supplies the final bounded occasion against which earlier night windows are measured.

changed_reading.before: The focus has no temporal texture beyond a completed past arrival.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory echo, it asks whether remembrance still has an interval after the audience missed the marked windows in which revelation and rescue move.

strongest_changes: The isolated messenger became the human-facing endpoint of a staged transmission whose intended output was remembrance.
Delay, due completion, occasion, waiting, return, appointment, and boiling made the focus question sensitive to a missed response window.
مُّبِين became disclosure that manifests and separates, not merely verbal lucidity.
Relational reception and procedural notice coexist: the audience severed trust even though warning had already been made inspectable.
summary.what_was_special: The split mapping of أَنَّىٰ kept a non-dominant time branch live, while the later مهل delay-or-molten crossover and boiling imagery activated the focus branch of reaching due completion, including heat reaching its limit. Material vessel, flow, night-window, and honor readings remained contained rather than being normalized away.
remaining_uncertainties: The vessel, night-interval, flowing-yield, and rights-document activations are branch-backed but form-distant from the immediate focus syntax.
مُّبِين may describe an intrinsically clear messenger, an active clarifier, or the boundary-producing effect of his arrival; the context sustains all three unevenly.
The context supplies sequences and reversals but does not itself prove the reader-supplied causal arrows linking missed reception to later punishment.
